map.小颗粒在低雷诺数下的匀速沉降速度。: The uniform settling velocity of small particles at low Reynolds number.
map.v = 2r²(ρ_p−ρ_f)g/(9μ)。 适用低雷诺数小球。: v = 2r²(ρ_p−ρ_f)g/(9μ), for small spheres at low Reynolds number.
map.适用低雷诺数小球。: It applies to small spheres at low Reynolds number.
map.v = (rho_p-rho_f)*g*d^2/(18*mu)。例：沙 d=10: v = (rho_p-rho_f)*g*d^2/(18*mu). Example: sand with d=100 μm, Δrho=1600 and water mu=1e-3 gives v=1600*9.81*1e-8/(18e-3)=8.7e-3 m/s.
map.Rep<1 的细颗粒层流沉降。: particles with Rep below 1 settling in laminar flow.
map.超出斯托克斯区改用阻力系数法。: Beyond the Stokes regime, switch to the drag coefficient method.
map.斯托克斯沉降速度（本页代码口径）：v=2×r²×(ρ_p−ρ_f)×g÷(9×μ: Stokes settling velocity (as implemented here): v=2×r²×(ρ_p−ρ_f)×g÷(9×μ) (m/s, r particle radius in m, ρ_p particle density, ρ_f fluid density in kg/m³, μ viscosity in Pa·s, g gravitational acceleration in m/s²). Validation: blank input in any of the five fields prompts a message and stops. Criteria: the page does not enforce a Reynolds-number check; the formula applies only to small-particle settling in the low-Reynolds-number laminar regime, and velocity grows with the square of the radius.
